deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page: no formulas, no computations and no derivations. Folio 56v is a heavily revised German prose draft of an official report or memorandum (Gutachten). It continues the administrative text of the previous page. That page dealt with Prussia's (General-Lieutenant J. J. Baeyer's) invitation to join the Central European Arc Measurement (Mitteleuropäische Gradmessung, c. 1861-63) and with Riemann being commissioned to negotiate with Baeyer.

The legible content runs as follows. A struck opening ('durch die ... ein'). Then a sentence roughly: 'we take the liberty [to attach] ... in connection with this wish, a [memorandum] prompted by this report, so as to be able to refer later on to the motives developed in it.' A cancelled clause mentions something 'in der Akademie'. Next come several abandoned starts: '[Einrichtung/Errichtung] ...', 'eine spezielle Anordnung', 'und dieser Gegenstand dürfte sich', 'doch enthalten', 'Doch enthalten wir uns ... wagen'. These show the author repeatedly reformulating one closing sentence.

The final, uncancelled version reads: 'Doch dürfte für die Beschaffung der hierzu erforderlichen Apparate eine günstige Gelegenheit abzuwarten sein und enthalten wir uns daher, gegenwärtig hierauf näher einzugehen.' In English: 'However, for procuring the apparatus required for this, a favourable opportunity should probably be awaited, and we therefore refrain from going into this in more detail at present.'

The lower part holds only isolated struck fragments ('die', 'dies', '... doch'). In context (see the next page), the 'apparatus' are the instruments for comparative pendulum (gravity) observations linked by electric telegraph, after Airy's method. Riemann proposes these to determine local deflections of the vertical affecting the Hanoverian arc measurement. The scientific idea of using gravity measurements to study local plumb-line deflections appears on the neighbouring page, not here. This page only defers the question of acquiring instruments.

results.what: Administrative drafting: deferral of procurement of pendulum/gravimetric apparatus for a proposed study of local plumb-line deflections in connection with the Central European Arc Measurement (Baeyer).
results.modern_name: Geodetic science policy / instrument procurement (no mathematical content)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a non-mathematical prose draft of a bureaucratic report. Riemann's involvement in the Göttingen response to Baeyer's Gradmessung initiative is documented (it is reflected in his Nachlass and in biographical literature). This page adds nothing beyond wording about postponing the purchase of apparatus.
transcription_corrections: Line 2: 'eine durch diesen Vortrag veranlasste' is likely spelled 'veranlaßte' in the manuscript, consistent with Riemann's orthography elsewhere.

Final sentence: the interlinear insertion '{+hierzu erforderlichen+}' replaces a struck word that looks more like 'nöthigen' or similar. The reading 'Beschaffung der hierzu erforderlichen Apparate' is supported by the image.
The struck line read as 'Einrichtung[?]' may instead be 'Errichtung'; uncertain.
The struck lines 'doch enthalten' / 'Doch enthalten wir uns' / 'Doch enthalten wir uns ... wagen' are successive abandoned attempts at the final sentence, not independent text.

The last-line fragments at the bottom ('die', 'dies', '... doch') appear in a different, browner ink and are struck through. They are probably pen trials or later fragments, not part of the main draft.
